name: Primal Weapons survives a Disarm and follows the weapon type (#10805)
contract: Primal Weapons 537218 ("which when used will grant you a bonus based on whether you use one-handed weapons or
two-handed weapons") casts Primal Weapon: Bestial Might 801242 with a one-handed weapon or Primal Might 704098 with a
two-handed one. Both carried the DBC's equipped-weapon requirement, so a Disarm stripped the buff and nothing
restored it when the Disarm ended: the Wildwalker had to press the button again after every Disarm. The weapon
requirement is cleared on those two spells; AscensionPrimalistWeapons keeps the buff matched to the main-hand
weapon when the slot changes (a swap to another weapon type drops it, and it is not restored by itself). A level 27
Wildwalker equips a one-handed axe, uses Primal Weapons and is disarmed by Disarm 676: Bestial Might must stay
through the disarm and after it. Swapping to a two-handed axe must drop Bestial Might.

steps.label: Use Primal Weapons with a one-handed axe
